findings.explanation: The Vela `complete` callback completes the API call. The handler clears the task ID that `success` just stored, so a subsequent idle frame or urgent warning cannot stop the active turn pattern. A Node mock using `success` followed by `complete` reproduced cancellation issuing zero `stop` calls. Retain the ID until cancellation or a confirmed task end. [Vela callback semantics](https://iot.mi.com/vela/quickapp/en/features/grammar.html#asynchronous-api-calls) [Vela vibrator API](https://iot.mi.com/vela/quickapp/en/features/system/vibrator.html)

A backward clock adjustment can still restore an expired arrow if the new time remains after `lastRecv`. A Node probe reproduced `stale` followed by `nav` without a new frame. Compare against the highest clock reading observed since the accepted frame and latch loss on rollback, or measure elapsed time with a monotonic clock.

Distance is extracted before the immediate clause is isolated. `Turn right, then in 30 m turn left` pairs the right-turn arrow with 30 m and triggers the urgent alert for the wrong step. Isolate the immediate instruction before looking for an embedded maneuver distance, while retaining support for a standalone distance field.

An explicitly ambiguous primary instruction is represented by the same `M_UNKNOWN` value as an unrecognized instruction. With primary text `Turn left or right` and expanded text `Turn right onto Main Street`, the fallback restores a right arrow and can trigger a turn alert. Preserve the primary result's ambiguity and block maneuver fallback in that case.

The distance search accepts a suffix of an invalid or space-grouped number. `- 30 m` becomes 30 m and `1 050 m` becomes 50 m, both within the urgent range. A focused regex probe confirmed both matches. Validate the whole numeric token, including signs and grouping spaces, and either parse valid grouping or return `d=-1`.

The bare `arrived` alternative still treats an uncompleted arrival as completed. For example, `You haven't arrived yet` produces `k=3`, `d=0` and clears guidance. Match affirmative completed-arrival phrases and exclude negated or conditional phrases.

`rerouteRx` scans all primary and expanded text after the maneuver selection. An expanded `Recalculating route` field can therefore turn a recognized primary `Turn left` into `k=2` and hide the arrow. Apply primary-field precedence to rerouting detection as well.

The timeout clears the server-wide slot before the platform confirms completion. If A's callback arrives after a second notify to A is submitted, line 326 releases that newer send because both callbacks carry the same address. Clearing the slot on disconnect creates the same risk after reconnect. Keep the outstanding slot until completion, or rebuild the GATT generation on timeout so its delayed callback cannot release a later send. [Android notification callback contract](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/bluetooth/BluetoothGattServerCallback#onNotificationSent(android.bluetooth.BluetoothDevice,int))

An asynchronous service-registration failure only updates status. A terminal advertising failure at line 229, or an advertising exception at line 195, does the same. In each case the foreground service can remain marked running and renew its wake lock indefinitely without an advertised GATT service. Propagate terminal startup failures to the service and close that generation.

The response helper obtains the GATT reference under the lock and releases it before the platform call. A descriptor read or rejected write can race with `stopLocked()` and call `sendResponse` on the closed server. The exception status update also checks generation outside the lock. Serialize the generation check, platform response and error-status update with teardown.

The UI preview invokes the same builder as the BLE send. If an MTU-23 peer cannot fit the core, the BLE build sets the warning and the immediately following 180-byte preview build clears it before the UI refresh. Make preview generation side-effect-free and derive the warning from actual subscribed-peer build results.

A post that replaces the selected notification under the same key and clears `FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT` is ignored. The old turn remains active until its freshness window expires, even though the selected source no longer qualifies. Clear the selected key and publish idle when that key is updated to a non-ongoing notification.

The page reports a duplicate, out-of-order or retired frame as success to BLE. Those frames can establish readiness and keep renewing the watchdog while the HUD receives no acceptable sequence updates. Renew readiness and the watchdog only when the sequence filter accepts the frame. Preserve the contract's shared sequence filter across transports.

With two Moto Nav peripherals using different tokens and no pinned address, the first result is picked on every attempt. If the other peripheral consistently responds first, token filtering drops its frames but the retry keeps choosing it, leaving the intended phone undiscovered. On a failed first-frame attempt, try another matching address before retrying the same one.

The first received navigation frame can already be stale, such as when the phone reseeds from a Maps notification posted 14 seconds earlier. `tick()` nevertheless returns `lost`, producing a loss vibration before any fresh guidance was available. A Node probe reproduced this. Arm the loss vibration only after fresh navigation guidance has been accepted.

If the subscription acknowledgement is delivered after the first accepted frame, its handler overwrites `C nối` with `C chờ tin`. Subsequent frames do not restore the status because `gotFrame` is already true. Skip the waiting status and first-frame timer once a frame has been accepted.

A live BLE idle heartbeat correctly leaves the local demo running, but a subsequent loss of that live channel cancels the shared vibrator even when the demo owns its current pattern. Invalidate live state on loss and leave the demo's vibration alone while the demo is active.

Clear lists files before taking the capture lock and deletes them after releasing it. If the worker is writing a set while clear enumerates the directory, files created after enumeration survive and can leave a partial set. Serialize enumeration, deletion and dedupe reset with capture writes.

The notification-permission row checks the combined permission list. A user who grants notification permission but declines Bluetooth is shown that notification permission is missing. Check `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` independently when rendering that row.

The v1.2 sample omits the required `p` key, so the watch rejects the example as written. Add the default token to the example and document that `r` is dropped after `s` when the core still does not fit with `r`, matching the implementation at line 35 of `PayloadBuilder.kt`.

The first review's README finding remains open. The root README still marks both applications as unstarted and the project as research, so readers miss the implemented build and sideload paths. Update the status and link the two app READMEs.

limits: No Git metadata or baseline diff was available. Attribution is based on the current source, the first review and the controller's description of the fixes.

Ran targeted read-only Node probes for haptic callback ordering, clock rollback, an initially stale frame and the distance regex. Parser outcomes beyond the regex probes were traced from the Kotlin source. The controller supplied the unit-test, lint, APK and RPK results.
Real Watch S5 behavior, BLE and MTU negotiation, Android permission and wake-lock behavior, layout and real Google Maps notifications remain unverified.
The controller excluded BLE encryption and authentication beyond the clear-text token, and accepted the brief pulse possible before an asynchronous vibration task ID becomes available.
